notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Zombies.
description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {R}.
Repeat.
